column3: Re-examine Cache-control: no-store is deliberate (stale pane JS hid a bug once)
Cross-domain JS: office.js must load from Microsoft's CDN
No SRI: Microsoft updates hosted office.js in place, a hash would break the pane
HSTS: browsers ignore HSTS for IP addresses; engine is 127.0.0.1 only
Spectre isolation (COEP/CORP): would block the cross-origin office.js
Permissions-Policy: pane uses no camera/mic/location; nothing to switch off
